parties: Jayantha Wickremasinghe Gunasekara alias Kananke Dhammadinna v. Jayatissa Wickremasinghe Gunasekara and Others Jayantha Wickremasinghe Gunasekara alias Kananke Dhammadinna v. Jayatissa Wickremasinghe Gunasekara and Others View More
keywords: Revision under Article 138 of the Constitution; dispute over possession between two brothers under Section 66 of the Primary Court Procedure Act; whether an appeal under Article 154P(3)(b) automatically stays execution of a High Court revisionary order. Held - High Court judgement set aside and Magistrate’s determination restored as endeavour to settle under Section 66(7) considered satisfied (doctrine of approbation and reprobation applies).
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Primary Court Procedure Act
